 Order

This appeal is filed under Section 20 of the Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act,
1957 being aggrieved of award dated 16.3.2016 passed by the Tribunal at Singrauli constituted under the Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, 1957 in Case No.12/2012 directing the appellants to pay compensation in regard to the land as contained in Survey No.125/3 measuring 1 Acre and the house etc @ Rs.4,15,000/- alongwith interest or to pay compensation in regard to the said land, if it is not already decided within a period of three months.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellants submits that the impugned order is illegal and arbitrary.
The land was already vested in the Government of India under the Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, 1957 and, therefore, the Government of India was a necessary party.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Since the Northern Coalfields Limited is a Public Sector Undertaking, therefore, it was not sued in proper name.
The Tribunal has failed to take into consideration the aspect of limitation.
There were no documents before the Tribunal to substantiate the ownership of the affected party.
Under such premise, the impugned award has been assailed by filing the present appeal.
Learned counsel for the respondents submits that the award is well reasoned.
Technical issues are being raised.

The Tribunal has dealt with all the aspects, which are necessary for determination of compensation in the matter of the land acquisition and after framing four issues and recording a finding that Shri Jugal Kishore of Village Naudhiya, Tahsil Chintrangi, District Sidhi ( Now Singrauli) was owner of the land as contained in Survey No.125/3 measuring 1 Acre and was in possession of the said land and arriving at a correct valuation has passed the impugned award,
which does not call for any interference in this appeal.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties.
There is no material on record to substantiate the grounds taken by the appellants and in absence of any material to substance the grounds, this appeal fails and is dismissed.

Record, if any, be sent back.
(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE amit Director (Tecdhnical) vs Jagal Prasad Yadav (Dead) Thr. Lrs. ...
